Austin was very understanding, and he began regularly sending new listings for me to review. When we were ready to buy, we reconnected with Austin to give an update on the types of property we were interested in and Austin was a great teammate. He provided useful resources including a guide to various Ohio neighborhoods, a rolodex of helpful contacts, and expertise about the market. As we narrowed our focus to some specific properties, Austin was a great sounding board. I would share properties I was considering and Austin would provide his thoughts, local rents, and recent sales data.

Once we picked the property we wanted to move on, Austin was key to getting things done. He communicated effectively with the selling agent and helped us put in a competitive offer. While there were higher offers than ours, Austin structured ours in such a way that ours was accepted! Austin then helped us coordinate the next steps with the property inspector, regularly making himself available for calls and quickly responding to texts whenever we had any questions. With his guidance, we were able to request and obtain a decrease in the selling price based on the results of the inspection. He regularly provided timely updates to us and ensured everything moved forward without any issues. Austin was an effective go-between, helping coordinate the closing and next steps with the selling agent, title company, and property manager. 

We had a terrific experience working with Austin and highly recommend him. We look forward to working with him on future deals!
